title: Restore existing dev-login transport without changing security policy
acceptance: Existing dev-login endpoint and runtime bridge produce a short-lived session for the dev FE without embedding a bearer token.
Hosted read-only /bff/me, personas, dashboard summary, incidents, and assistant mode no longer fail solely because the browser has no session.
Strict fallback, write-disabled defaults, role/tenant/MFA/token policy, route authorization, CORS, and security task set are unchanged.
Exact FE/BFF/deployment identities, redacted smoke output, rollback path, checks, and independent review are archived.
non_goals: No mock/seed fallback in hosted strict mode
No live writes or capital/broker side effects
dispatch_rules: Use clean task worktrees in both repositories.
Any diff that changes security policy is out of scope and must be rejected.
Owner and reviewer must be distinct fleet identities.
Only read-only dev deployment evidence is permitted.
